text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Ahem. Excuse me. Please continue<n>as you were.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Um... You know that courtroom TV<n>drama
everyone's been talking<n>about? It was about that...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Please, don't ask me any more. I'm<n>already
embarrassed about that little<n>outburst...

However, another "Objection!" rings<n>out ten
minutes later. It seems like<n>Biwa Hayahide's not
getting enough<n>sleep.
